label: HA Stock App Notifications
info:
Sends ha_stock_app_* events to notify.mobile_app_owner.

Each listener subscribes to ONE event type. The Home Assistant
websocket client passes that type to subscribe_events, so HA only
sends those events -- state_changed never reaches Node-RED.

Never blank an Event Type field: an empty one subscribes to the whole
bus and floods the websocket queue.

Set the action on the Mobile Notify node to your own device.
